summary: TriLinc Global Impact Fund LLC filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to provide a routine portfolio update as of July 31, 2026. The registrant reported portfolio assets of approximately $283 million, aggregate investments of about $1.210 billion to 103 borrower companies, and total repayments of roughly $908.1 million. The filing contains no transaction, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event. It is a routine operational disclosure. There are no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations. The filing is ordinary for a business development company and does not constitute a corporate action. What to watch: no ongoing special-situation catalyst; continued portfolio performance reporting.
